ns2:section.sectionText: Section GV: The Global Village: Viewing the World Through Children's Literature. This course will use children's literature to explore the world through children's eyes. Students will examine different cultures, communities, families, and customs from around the world through the genres of picture books, contemporary realistic fiction, nonfiction, biography/autobiography, and poetry. Students will also read about some of the issues and problems facing the world's children, such as war, poverty, disease, and the environment. Learning will take place primarily through reading and discussions. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to Freshmen. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
